data.name: Abhishek Nishad
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Abhishek Nishad has made a big mark in cricket. With 6 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 24*, with an average of 8.80 and a quick strike rate of 141.94. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 2 sixes and 7 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 7.0 overs, taking 7 wickets at an economy rate of 12.00. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
